text:
izzy: quick share — we just crossed $18M ARR this quarter. stunned and proud. 
marco: whoa, incredible. huge congrats team :tada: :confetti_ball:
priya: this is the best news i've heard all week. all the late nights paid off <3
oliver: shoutout to sales for the push and to eng for the reliability work. cookies for ops?
izzy: cookies + cupcakes? maybe both. in-office mini-party tomorrow at 3pm?
marco: i'm bringing the paper banner. who's on balloon duty?
priya: i'll get balloons and a tiny confetti cannon (low power)
ops-bot: alert: deployment 2026.03.22-9 succeeded on production. latency p95 stable.
oliver: ops-bot flex appreciated. also, can someone make a two-sentence announcement for #announcements?
izzy: draft: "We hit $18M ARR this quarter — massive thanks to every team. Snacks and a short toast tomorrow 3pm in the kitchen." feedback?
priya: add: "special thanks to onboarding and infra for the smooth rollouts."
marco: plus a kudos to customer success for closing the big enterprise deal 
izzy: updated. posting in 5.
oliver: tiny poll: cake? cupcakes? fruit? reply +1 cake, +2 cupcakes, +3 fruit
priya: +2
marco: +1
izzy: +2
ops-bot: reaction :tada: added by izzy
marco: who wants to be in the 3pm photo? quick team pic for the blog and socials
priya: count me in. ill bring a disposable camera for peak nostalgia 
oliver: i'll bring my "I debugged in production" hat. wear at your own risk 
izzy: thank you everyone. this feels surreal. onward to the next milestone 10M users? maybe we dream big.
marco: dream big. celebrate now. then ship. :rocket:
